name: anun333/oe-module-behavioral-health
description: 42 CFR Part 2 consents and disclosures for OpenEMR: each disclosure tied to its consent in OpenEMR's own Disclosures record, with the 2.32 notice and the accounting of disclosures.

footprint-not-covered: Whether the permission checks above behave correctly for restricted users. The end-to-end check refuses a login without patients/disclosure every page, and lets one with add-only access record but not revoke; the README's "Who can open what" section lists the levels.

Whether a disclosure stays within its consent's scope: staff confirm that, since the module can't read the signed form. The unit tests in `tests/` cover the consent rules; the end-to-end check is described in the CHANGELOG.
